item.title: [Due in 1 day] Defender for Servers stops billing Windows 10/11 and other desktops as servers on 1 November and counts every machine separately, golden-image clones included
item.description:
Multi-session and VDI hosts protected today through Defender for Servers Plan 1 move to a Defender for Endpoint licensing route; a host that falls between the two is where coverage silently lapses.

Azure · deadline 2026-11-01 · Before 1 November list Plan 1 machines whose OS is a client SKU (including AVD multi-session) and confirm each has a Defender for Endpoint licence; check golden-image clones that share an Arc ID, because each now counts separately.

item.title: [Due today] Azure Blueprints stops accepting new assignments on 31 October, and its resource locks stop working at full retirement
item.description:
Blueprint assignments can apply Do Not Delete and Read Only locks. Those locks stop functioning at retirement, so any resource whose protection rests on a blueprint lock silently loses it — and the definitions that describe what was being protected are deleted at the same time.

Azure · deadline 2026-10-31 · Export every blueprint definition, version and assignment you intend to keep before 31 January 2027, and before 31 October decide the replacement for each lock: Azure Policy deny or denyAction for the rule, and a resource lock for the deletion protection.
